explanation: `IsPositiveDefiniteSub` is defined in the library itself (TauCeti/Analysis/PositiveDefinite/AddGroup.lean). It says that for every n, every coefficient vector c and every family v of points, ∑ c_i conj(c_j) F(v_i - v_j) ≥ 0. I grepped Mathlib for "PositiveDefinite" and got no matches, so Mathlib has no notion of a positive-definite function. The theorem goes from `Matrix.PosSemidef` of the kernel F(a - b) to this library predicate. Its proof uses the library's own lemmas (`isPositiveDefiniteSub_iff_isPositiveDefinite`, `IsPositiveDefinite.of_posSemidef`), plus Mathlib's generic `Matrix.PosSemidef.submatrix` and a `simp` step. None of these is a single Mathlib declaration that states the result, so the mathematical content sits in the library's own definitions.
